dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast visibility of multiple thin, white curved margins on the median and greater coverts, creating a scalloped effect rather than solid horizontal bands.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Extremely prominent and sharp white boundaries on the outer edges of the folded primary and secondary feathers against the dark grey internal feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; the plumage pattern exhibits a gradual shift in scale from fine stippling on the crown to larger scalloped shapes on the mantle without a linear boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-contrast orange-red marker is visible on the bird's right leg area (viewer's left), characteristic of a synthetic identification band.
other_distinctive_markers: The entire dorsal surface is defined by highly uniform and repetitive white-fringed scalloping against dark grey-black centers.
